Welcome to Advanced Prosthetics

At Advanced Prosthetics, we combine cutting-edge technology with compassionate patient care. Our
team offers customized treatment plans, backed by extensive training, education, and experience,
ensuring you receive reliable and timely solutions for your healthcare needs.

[Explore Our Products & Services][69]

[

#### Office Locations

][70] [

#### Our Clinicians

][71] [

#### Patient Resources

][72]

# Who We Are

We provide custom prosthetic and orthotic solutions designed to restore mobility, comfort, and
independence. Whether you need a new limb, brace, or other supportive device, our team combines
advanced technology with compassionate care to create the best fit for your life. With offices
across North and South Carolina, we offer free consultations and flexible payment options to make
care accessible for every patient.

## Products & Services

#### Advanced Prosthetics sees patients of all age ranges. Whether it is pediatrics or geriatrics,
#### no patient is beyond our reach.

We provide a full range of services encompassing all aspects of prosthetics, orthotics and wound
care. Our company has some of the most technologically advanced systems on the market. It is our
duty to our patients to offer the latest and greatest components and techniques that are suited for
their lifestyles. Our main goal is to keep patients active and comfortable.

## Hear What Other Patients Have to Say

## Recommended to Anyone

The crew at Advanced Prosthetics has been wonderful and very knowledgeable on my fitting of shoes.
They are all very polite and hospitable. Andy has been on point with my fittings. I would recommend
him to anyone that needs a fitting.

Steve W.

## Great Team All Around

Great team all around! They fitted my sweet mother with a brace and it literally fit like a glove…
perfect! Not only were they efficient but also extremely helpful in ensuring she was comfortable and
all our questions were answered. AND our clinician must be a comedian part-time because he kept us
laughing! The office manager was incredibly nice, patient and efficient in running the front office.
This team… couldn’t speak more highly of them. Give them a call and/or visit. You will NOT be
disappointed!

Corey P. | Columbia, SC

## Professional & Caring

Staff are professional and caring. Questions are encouraged and answered. Technicians are empathetic
and determined to assure your orthotics fit your needs. BEST Orthotics service I have received in
over 20+ years! The admin staff are efficient and personable. The members on staff at this Anderson,
SC location have been outstanding in providing my care. Thank you!

Donna S.

## Very Pleased

I’m very pleased with my inserts from Advanced Prosthetics and even more pleased with the customer
service I received. Andy and Barbara definitely believes in customer satisfaction. One of the best
customer experience I’ve ever received. I highly recommend this place and will definitely return for
future needs.

Rachel T.

## Excellent Service

Excellent service! Great people. Every visit leaves the impression that I am the number one
customer. Fit and finish of product are always fantastic. Well done. Highest recommendation!

Timothy F. [ [1] ][1]

# Allard USA

Welcome to Allard USA, your O&P Partner! Our aim is to provide technical support, superior products
and service excellence, ensuring a positive difference to Patients’ lives!

[About Allard USA][45]

## Our orthotic and prosthetic solutions provide Support for better life for people with mobility
## challenges.

[
][46]
NEW! ToeUP™ Textile Foot Drop Orthosis
ToeUP is a textile ankle-foot orthosis (AFO) designed for patients with milder forms of drop foot.
It features various adjustable and interchangeable parts, allowing it to be customised to individual
needs.
[ Learn more about ToeUP][47]
[
][48]
Education
We offer training and technical support to ensure that the unique features of our products are put
to good use.
[ Learn more][49]

NEW! Meracus Prosthetic Foot

Crafted from 100% composite materials, Meracus® sets a new standard in prosthetic design. Brought to
you by the dedicated team behind the Allard AFO, Meracus® is a prosthetic foot designed for a
seamless gait experience.

[Discover Meracus][50]

Soft Good Orthoses

Allard's Soft Good Orthoses utilize fabrics engineered for comfort with support and stabilization to
heal and relieve pain.

[Read more][51]

Carbon Footplate Rigid

The new Carbon Footplate Rigid has been developed to provide extra support and stability while
contributing to improved balance and push-off at the end of the stance phase.

[Visit product page][52]

INSPIRATION

# Maximizing the Benefits of Your AFO

Being diagnosed with a neurological disease can be challenging. Regular exercise based on individual
conditions is an important part of rehabilitation and contributes to both physical and mental
health.

[Check out our exercise tips!][53]

USER STORIES

## Jessica shares her story about life with foot drop

Jessica went on a long journey from misdiagnosis to reinvention, working through challenges and
triumphs while living with Charcot-Marie-Tooth. Hear Jessica elaborate on how Allard AFOs boosted
her confidence and enhanced her quality of life.

[Hear Jessica's story][54]

DISTRIBUTORS

distributors.

[See more][55]

Dralla Foundation
The Dralla Foundation is the philanthropic arm of Allard USA, established by Peter Allard, the
founder and owner of Allard USA. Its mission is to support programs designed to provide children and
adults with physical challenges the opportunity to experience fun and memorable days. Since its
inception in 2011, the Foundation has facilitated unforgettable experiences for over 4,000
individuals through its grant-making initiatives.
[ Learn about Dralla][57]

Join the global support movement for people living with mobility challenges like Foot Drop.

# Welcome to Hanger Clinic

Expert Orthotic and Prosthetic Care in Chicago

[ Request an appointment ][52]

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. We create customized solutions for people of all ages,
including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, cranial helmets, and other devices designed to
increase the mobility and function of each person we serve.

[Request an Appointment][53]

Whether you’re visiting a former Scheck & Siress location or another Hanger Clinic location, we
provide dedicated, high-quality care focused on you, our patients. Scheck & Siress provided the
highest level of orthotic and prosthetic care for years before joining Hanger Clinic, and continues
to do so as part of the Hanger Clinic family, with the added benefits of additional resources.

## Find a Clinic Near You

Choose a convenient Chicago area location from the list below, or [search all of our clinics][54].

## Explore Our Expertise

### *****The peace of mind you need. The commitment you deserve.*****

We create customized solutions—including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, supports, cranial
helmets, and other devices—designed to help you live your best life. Our commitment is to listen to
you, get to know you as a person, and do everything we can to help you achieve your potential.

[male patient with above-knee prosthesis sitting on steps]

## Lower Limb Prosthetics

With solutions for all levels of lower limb loss and limb difference, including above-knee
amputation and below-knee amputation, our expert prosthetists will work with you to find the best
prosthetic solution for you.

***Technology Highlights:***
* [Microprocessor Knees][55]
* [Microprocessor Feet][56]
* [Hydraulic Ankle/Feet][57]

[male clinician with male patient with right arm prosthesis]

## Upper Limb Prosthetics

Our upper limb specialists design custom prosthetic solutions for people needing prosthetic arms,
hands, and fingers. Our advanced materials and state-of-the-art components work with you and empower
you to continue to do the things you love.

***Technology Highlight:***
* [*Myoelectric Hooks and Hands*][58]

## Cranial Helmets

Cranial remolding helmets are often prescribed to treat cranial asymmetry, like plagiocephaly, also
known as “flat head syndrome.” We are here to help put your mind at ease by providing you with the
expertise, education, and support you need to feel comfortable and confident about the journey
ahead.

[Learn More >][59]

## Lower Limb Bracing

Our clinicians work with individuals of all ages and offer a full range of treatment options ranging
from sports orthoses for young athletes to specialty orthoses to help treat a variety of
neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders including cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and down
syndrome.

[Learn More >][60]

## Scoliosis Bracing

A spine doctor may prescribe a scoliosis brace, also known as a Thoracic Lumbar Sacral Orthosis
(TLSO) for your child. The TLSO works by applying pressure over the back in specific areas to
straighten the spine while your child is wearing the brace.

[Learn More >][61]

### Owned and operated by ABC certified prosthetists, Thermo-Ply is a privately owned company
### located in St. Petersburg, Florida.  For many years, Thermo-Ply has manufactured prosthetic
### liners and sleeves for numerous companies in the O&P market.  While we continue to supply these
### services, we are excited to announce our own line of prosthetic liners and sleeves. 

## OUR MISSION

### At Thermo-Ply our mission is to design and manufacture top quality prosthetic products to
### benefit the lives of all amputees.  We achieve this by controlling every step of prototyping,
### testing, manufacturing, packaging and shipping processes to ensure you receive the highest
### quality product for your patient at a competitive price.

Welcome to Advanced Prosthetics

At Advanced Prosthetics, we combine cutting-edge technology with compassionate patient care. Our
team offers customized treatment plans, backed by extensive training, education, and experience,
ensuring you receive reliable and timely solutions for your healthcare needs.

# Who We Are

We provide custom prosthetic and orthotic solutions designed to restore mobility, comfort, and
independence. Whether you need a new limb, brace, or other supportive device, our team combines
advanced technology with compassionate care to create the best fit for your life. With offices
across North and South Carolina, we offer free consultations and flexible payment options to make
care accessible for every patient.

## Products & Services

#### Advanced Prosthetics sees patients of all age ranges. Whether it is pediatrics or geriatrics,
#### no patient is beyond our reach.

We provide a full range of services encompassing all aspects of prosthetics, orthotics and wound
care. Our company has some of the most technologically advanced systems on the market. It is our
duty to our patients to offer the latest and greatest components and techniques that are suited for
their lifestyles. Our main goal is to keep patients active and comfortable.

# Allard USA

Welcome to Allard USA, your O&P Partner! Our aim is to provide technical support, superior products
and service excellence, ensuring a positive difference to Patients’ lives!

[About Allard USA][45]

## Our orthotic and prosthetic solutions provide Support for better life for people with mobility
## challenges.

[
][46]
NEW! ToeUP™ Textile Foot Drop Orthosis
ToeUP is a textile ankle-foot orthosis (AFO) designed for patients with milder forms of drop foot.
It features various adjustable and interchangeable parts, allowing it to be customised to individual
needs.
[ Learn more about ToeUP][47]
[
][48]
Education
We offer training and technical support to ensure that the unique features of our products are put
to good use.
[ Learn more][49]

NEW! Meracus Prosthetic Foot

Crafted from 100% composite materials, Meracus® sets a new standard in prosthetic design. Brought to
you by the dedicated team behind the Allard AFO, Meracus® is a prosthetic foot designed for a
seamless gait experience.

[Discover Meracus][50]

Soft Good Orthoses

Allard's Soft Good Orthoses utilize fabrics engineered for comfort with support and stabilization to
heal and relieve pain.

[Read more][51]

Carbon Footplate Rigid

The new Carbon Footplate Rigid has been developed to provide extra support and stability while
contributing to improved balance and push-off at the end of the stance phase.

[Visit product page][52]

INSPIRATION

# Maximizing the Benefits of Your AFO

Being diagnosed with a neurological disease can be challenging. Regular exercise based on individual
conditions is an important part of rehabilitation and contributes to both physical and mental
health.

[Check out our exercise tips!][53]

USER STORIES

## Jessica shares her story about life with foot drop

Jessica went on a long journey from misdiagnosis to reinvention, working through challenges and
triumphs while living with Charcot-Marie-Tooth. Hear Jessica elaborate on how Allard AFOs boosted
her confidence and enhanced her quality of life.

[Hear Jessica's story][54]

distributors.

Dralla Foundation
The Dralla Foundation is the philanthropic arm of Allard USA, established by Peter Allard, the
founder and owner of Allard USA. Its mission is to support programs designed to provide children and
adults with physical challenges the opportunity to experience fun and memorable days. Since its
inception in 2011, the Foundation has facilitated unforgettable experiences for over 4,000
individuals through its grant-making initiatives.

and business solutions that enhance mobility, improve patient outcomes, and streamline operations.

left her with a full ACL tear and a partial MCL tear. Breg’s Cold Therapy has helped her manage
swelling, reduce pain, and stay more consistent with her recovery routine.

#### [Game-Changing Recovery Routine][145]

Shaili’s adventures have taken her many places, including the Mt. Everest Base Camp climb. As an
adventurer she is fearless, but sometimes the world pushes back. A ski accident in February of 2026
left her with a full ACL tear and a partial MCL tear. Breg’s Cold Therapy has helped her manage
swelling, reduce pain, and stay more consistent with her recovery routine.

#### [Regained My Flexibility][148]

Joey was actively competing in martial arts and fight contests when his patella tendon suddenly
ruptured. The pain was so intense that he was unable to walk for quite some time, putting him on the
sidelines. His doctor performed surgery on his knee and put him in a competitor’s knee brace, but
eventually switched the brace out for a Breg T Scope® Premier Post-Op Knee Brace after complaints of
the competitor’s brace being too uncomfortable. After only three months in our brace, Joey’s range
of motion in his knee had gone from only bending 5 degrees to 110 degrees!
[ Read More ][149]
[ [Leah Schulze wearing brace sits on beach with friend] ][150]

#### [The Journey To GOING PRO][154]

At just 25 years old, Christina Esposito’s knee has been through it all. It all began her freshman
year of college. She was at the top of her lacrosse game and earned a spot on Northwestern
University’s starting line-up as an attacker. She was practicing with her teammates before a game
day when she suddenly felt (and heard) multiple pops in her left knee. In a split second, she had
torn her lateral and medial meniscus, ACL and MCL, and suffered from an LCL sprain and multiple bone
contusions.

# Welcome to Hanger Clinic

Expert Orthotic and Prosthetic Care in Chicago

[ Request an appointment ][52]

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. We create customized solutions for people of all ages,
including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, cranial helmets, and other devices designed to
increase the mobility and function of each person we serve.

[Request an Appointment][53]

Whether you’re visiting a former Scheck & Siress location or another Hanger Clinic location, we
provide dedicated, high-quality care focused on you, our patients. Scheck & Siress provided the
highest level of orthotic and prosthetic care for years before joining Hanger Clinic, and continues
to do so as part of the Hanger Clinic family, with the added benefits of additional resources.

## Find a Clinic Near You

Choose a convenient Chicago area location from the list below, or [search all of our clinics][54].

## Explore Our Expertise

### *****The peace of mind you need. The commitment you deserve.*****

We create customized solutions—including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, supports, cranial
helmets, and other devices—designed to help you live your best life. Our commitment is to listen to
you, get to know you as a person, and do everything we can to help you achieve your potential.

[male patient with above-knee prosthesis sitting on steps]

## Lower Limb Prosthetics

With solutions for all levels of lower limb loss and limb difference, including above-knee
amputation and below-knee amputation, our expert prosthetists will work with you to find the best
prosthetic solution for you.

***Technology Highlights:***
* [Microprocessor Knees][55]
* [Microprocessor Feet][56]
* [Hydraulic Ankle/Feet][57]

[male clinician with male patient with right arm prosthesis]

## Upper Limb Prosthetics

Our upper limb specialists design custom prosthetic solutions for people needing prosthetic arms,
hands, and fingers. Our advanced materials and state-of-the-art components work with you and empower
you to continue to do the things you love.

***Technology Highlight:***
* [*Myoelectric Hooks and Hands*][58]

## Cranial Helmets

Cranial remolding helmets are often prescribed to treat cranial asymmetry, like plagiocephaly, also
known as “flat head syndrome.” We are here to help put your mind at ease by providing you with the
expertise, education, and support you need to feel comfortable and confident about the journey
ahead.

[Learn More >][59]

## Lower Limb Bracing

Our clinicians work with individuals of all ages and offer a full range of treatment options ranging
from sports orthoses for young athletes to specialty orthoses to help treat a variety of
neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders including cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and down
syndrome.

[Learn More >][60]

## Scoliosis Bracing

A spine doctor may prescribe a scoliosis brace, also known as a Thoracic Lumbar Sacral Orthosis
(TLSO) for your child. The TLSO works by applying pressure over the back in specific areas to
straighten the spine while your child is wearing the brace.

# Welcome to Hanger Clinic

Expert Orthotic and Prosthetic Care in Chicago

[ Request an appointment ][52]

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. We create customized solutions for people of all ages,
including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, cranial helmets, and other devices designed to
increase the mobility and function of each person we serve.

[Request an Appointment][53]

Whether you’re visiting a former Scheck & Siress location or another Hanger Clinic location, we
provide dedicated, high-quality care focused on you, our patients. Scheck & Siress provided the
highest level of orthotic and prosthetic care for years before joining Hanger Clinic, and continues
to do so as part of the Hanger Clinic family, with the added benefits of additional resources.

## Find a Clinic Near You

Choose a convenient Chicago area location from the list below, or [search all of our clinics][54].

## Explore Our Expertise

### *****The peace of mind you need. The commitment you deserve.*****

We create customized solutions—including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces, supports, cranial
helmets, and other devices—designed to help you live your best life. Our commitment is to listen to
you, get to know you as a person, and do everything we can to help you achieve your potential.

[male patient with above-knee prosthesis sitting on steps]

## Lower Limb Prosthetics

With solutions for all levels of lower limb loss and limb difference, including above-knee
amputation and below-knee amputation, our expert prosthetists will work with you to find the best
prosthetic solution for you.

***Technology Highlights:***
* [Microprocessor Knees][55]
* [Microprocessor Feet][56]
* [Hydraulic Ankle/Feet][57]

[male clinician with male patient with right arm prosthesis]

## Upper Limb Prosthetics

Our upper limb specialists design custom prosthetic solutions for people needing prosthetic arms,
hands, and fingers. Our advanced materials and state-of-the-art components work with you and empower
you to continue to do the things you love.

***Technology Highlight:***
* [*Myoelectric Hooks and Hands*][58]

## Cranial Helmets

Cranial remolding helmets are often prescribed to treat cranial asymmetry, like plagiocephaly, also
known as “flat head syndrome.” We are here to help put your mind at ease by providing you with the
expertise, education, and support you need to feel comfortable and confident about the journey
ahead.

[Learn More >][59]

## Lower Limb Bracing

Our clinicians work with individuals of all ages and offer a full range of treatment options ranging
from sports orthoses for young athletes to specialty orthoses to help treat a variety of
neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders including cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and down
syndrome.

[Learn More >][60]

## Scoliosis Bracing

A spine doctor may prescribe a scoliosis brace, also known as a Thoracic Lumbar Sacral Orthosis
(TLSO) for your child. The TLSO works by applying pressure over the back in specific areas to
straighten the spine while your child is wearing the brace.

[Learn More >][61]

idea that resonates with any company aiming to provide its product or service as the ideal solution
for its customers.

provider. Trufit is a name that can be used by a variety of types of startups, from online retail
and fashion to health and wellness services. The short name makes it easy to remember, pronounce,
and type, making it convenient for customers to find and interact with the company.

company that is capable of offering a perfect solution that fits the needs and desires of customers,
just as a tailored suit fits its wearer. It also speaks to a sense of trust and reliability, as the
name implies that the company’s product or service is the perfect fit for its customers.

# Expert Limb Loss Care, All in One Place

##### Explore Recovery With the ARMS Clinic

An amputation is a profound life event, but it doesn’t define your future. At The Center for
Amputation Rehabilitation Medicine and Surgery (ARMS) in New Jersey, you’ll find more than just an
amputation rehabilitation center—you’ll find a community dedicated to supporting every aspect of
your journey. Our experts in surgery, prosthetics, rehabilitation, and mental health work together
under one roof to help you regain strength, independence, and confidence. With our state-of-the-art
technology and compassionate care, we’ll guide you toward a future full of possibilities.

[ Request an appointment ][20]

in a modern clinic setting.]

modern prosthetic technology.]

## Leading the Way in Post-Amputation Recovery

At ARMS, we believe in treating the whole person, not just the condition. [Our multidisciplinary
team][21] brings together surgical expertise, prosthetics, rehabilitation, and mental health support
for patients afflicted with limb loss and amputation. There’s no need to navigate multiple
providers—you can find convenient care all in one place.

We collaborate with leading New Jersey specialists at [The Center for Hand & Upper Extremity
Surgery][22], Atlantic Hand Therapy Center, [Hanger Clinic][23], and Hackensack Meridian Health to
provide you with the highest level of integrated care. By combining advanced technology with
[innovative rehabilitation options][24], we empower our patients to reclaim their independence and
thrive in every aspect of life.

## Innovative Care, Life-Changing Outcomes

Recovering from limb loss comes with many challenges—managing pain, adjusting to a prosthetic,
rebuilding strength, and coping with the emotional impact. With the ARMS team, you don't have to
navigate these issues on your own. Our fully integrated care model means your recovery will be
comprehensive, with our specialized care and treatment options including:

precision at ARMS.]

[Mental Health]
Mental Health Support

## A Multidisciplinary Approach, All Under One Roof

Your care shouldn’t be fragmented. That’s why ARMS unites four specialized clinics to form one elite
team providing surgery, rehabilitation, prosthetics, and mental health support—all under one roof.
This complete spectrum of care ensures seamless communication, personalized treatment, and a
smoother path to recovery, so you can focus on rebuilding strength, mobility, and confidence.

## Leading the Way in Post-Amputation Recovery

At ARMS, we believe in treating the whole person, not just the condition. [Our multidisciplinary
team][21] brings together surgical expertise, prosthetics, rehabilitation, and mental health support
for patients afflicted with limb loss and amputation. There’s no need to navigate multiple
providers—you can find convenient care all in one place.

We collaborate with leading New Jersey specialists at [The Center for Hand & Upper Extremity
Surgery][22], Atlantic Hand Therapy Center, [Hanger Clinic][23], and Hackensack Meridian Health to
provide you with the highest level of integrated care. By combining advanced technology with
[innovative rehabilitation options][24], we empower our patients to reclaim their independence and
thrive in every aspect of life.

## Innovative Care, Life-Changing Outcomes

Recovering from limb loss comes with many challenges—managing pain, adjusting to a prosthetic,
rebuilding strength, and coping with the emotional impact. With the ARMS team, you don't have to
navigate these issues on your own. Our fully integrated care model means your recovery will be
comprehensive, with our specialized care and treatment options including:

[rehabilitation]

[Mental Health]

Your care shouldn’t be fragmented. That’s why ARMS unites four specialized clinics to form one elite
team providing surgery, rehabilitation, prosthetics, and mental health support—all under one roof.
This complete spectrum of care ensures seamless communication, personalized treatment, and a
smoother path to recovery, so you can focus on rebuilding strength, mobility, and confidence.

Global Disability Innovation Hub accelerates ideas into impact for a more just world - for disabled
people, and all people.

We work in 40+ countries and have reached 64 million people since 2016. A world-leading Academic
Research and Practice Centre based at UCL, we are the first WHO Global Collaborating Centre on
Assistive Technology.

## AT2030 programme: Testing ‘what works’ to improve access to life-changing AT for all

We bring effective solutions to market by testing new mechanisms and ambitious scaling pathways for
growth-ready accessible and assistive technology ventures. From incubating future tech inspired
solutions to delivering ecosystem interventions - we strengthen systems to make inclusion a reality
and embed disability innovation into national policy landscapes. Generating new evidence and
insights, we stimulate demand, deliver country pilots and create enabling markets environment for
AT in Low-and Middle- Income Countries. 

[at2030.org][33]
[A black woman holds an ipad for a black man, who looks at it intently]

## Centre for Digital Language Inclusion: Using AI to bridge the barrier between impaired speech and
## Automatic Speech Recognition

Harnessing the power of AI the centre develops inclusive solutions for people with communication
difficulties. With support from Google.org, we are collecting impaired and non-standard speech for
languages across Africa, South America and Europe for the first time. Currently Automatic Speech
Recognition (ASR) technology is not available to those who would most benefit: non-English-speaking
populations in low- middle- income countries, who often have the least access to AT and speech and
language therapy. Our open source data sets will change this.
 

[cdl-inclusion.com][34]
[UCL graduating image, with 30 students celebrating, throwing hats into the air]

## Disability, Design & Innovation MSc: our UCL based MSc to tackle global challenges from a new
## perspective.

Design engineering meet global policy and the societal context of disability, this multidisciplinary
programme takes theory into practice, equipping emerging pioneers to tackle the complex problems
faced by people with a range of disabilities. Designed for those passionate about creating
accessible and assistive technologies and inclusive designs, this programme equips students with the
skills to make a significant impact in disability innovation.

[More about our Masters Degree][35]

## Inclusive Cities, Global Action Report

Highlight

This report equips cities with practical but evidence-based actions to accelerate accessibility and
inclusion in their physical infrastructure, buildings, services and operation. Cities worldwide are
experiencing continued growth and increasing resource challenges. With resource constraints and
increasing global challenges (rising inequality, climate changes, pandemics), it is critical that
accessibility and inclusive design are seamlessly integrated into the planning and design of cities,
to create liveable and enjoyable cities and ensure persons with disabilities are not left behind. 

[Global Action Report][36] [Person in wheelchair approaching place of worship in India]

## The first World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre for Research on Assistive
## Technology

Highlight

Our UCL based Collaborating Centre supports WHO’s efforts to widen global access to Assistive
Technology around humanitarian response, driving advances in digital technology and artificial
intelligence, and working to develop and implement a One-Stop-Shop Model of Assistive Product
service provision. The centre pioneers key research and innovation on Assistive Technologies
worldwide.

[WHO Collaborating Centre][37] [A Kenyan women holding a mobile phone while smiling at the camera]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

# Welcome to Findlay American Prosthetics & Orthotics Centre

A Passion For Putting Patients First With Prosthetics & Orthotics.
**Your Future, Your Mobility, Our Expertise**
Dedicated to Excellence, Rooted in Compassion: Where Your Well-being Takes Centre Stage with Our
Prosthetic and Orthotic Care. Your Journey to Comfort, Mobility, and Confidence Begins Here.
[Make An Appointment][16]

## Prosthetic Fitting in Findlay, Ohio

Welcome to Findlay Prosthetic & Orthotic Centre, the leading provider of prosthetic and orthotic
services in Findlay, Ohio. Our mission is to offer perfect prosthetic fitting and comprehensive
orthotic solutions tailored to your unique needs. Our experienced team uses advanced technology to
ensure optimal mobility and comfort.

## About Us

Mr. Jeremy Berman L.P.O. was born & raised in rural Hancock County. As a youth Mr. Berman
participated in school athletics & scouting. As a culmination in scouting he achieved the Eagle
Scout Award. Mr. Berman graduated from Riverdale H.S. & was named Senior Student of the Year for
Hardin County Schools. Mr. Berman enlisted in the Ohio Army National Guard for an eight year
enlistment & during his service was deployed following the 9/11 attack. Mr. Berman graduated from
Bowling Green State University in Bowling Green, Ohio with an undergraduate degree in Human Movement
Science - Kinesiology with a minor in Sociology. Mr. Berman graduated from Northwestern Medical
School in Chicago, Illinois with a graduate degree in Orthotics and Prosthetics. Following two years
of residency Mr. Berman became a board certified/licensed practitioner in Prosthetics & Orthotics.
Over two decades Mr. Berman has been the managing partner of Findlay American Prosthetic - Orthotic
Centre in Findlay, Ohio. Mr. Berman is married with one child.
Mr. Berman is a proud second generation practitioner and facility owner. He began working with his
father Mr. Ken Berman L.P.O when he was 13 years old in the family business.
Mr. Kenneth Berman L.P.O. started the business in 1975. Mr. Berman also received his education from
Northwestern Medical school in Chicago, was an Eagle Scout, and an Air Force veteran. Mr. Berman was
active in the state of Ohio with establishing licensure for the profession and was one of the first
to become licensed. Mr. Berman found the profession extremely rewarding and has helped thousands of
amputees regain mobility. Mr. Berman is currently retired and happily living in Florida with his
wife.
[Gate Room - Findlay]

## Our Services

Our commitment is to provide personalized prosthetic & orthotic solutions that not only restore
function but also inspire confidence. Whether you're embarking on a new chapter after amputation or
seeking an upgrade for your current prosthetic or orthotic device, our team of experts is dedicated
to crafting solutions that align with your unique needs and aspirations.

## [Our Products][13]

Prosthetics can be a big part of your life and your identity. So, it’s only right you choose a
specialist to deliver the most comfortable, supportive and reliable prosthetics for your needs.
Freedom Prosthetics is a provider and fabricator of prosthetic limbs and care with clinic in Cairns.

## Products and Services:
* The latest technology in prosthetic carving with 3D scanning not previously available in Far North
  Queensland.
* Consulting physiotherapist and occupational therapist.
* Manufacture of all our custom devices on-site in Cairns with quick turn-around.
* Full range of prefabricated and customised orthotics systems available.
* Amputee support for any issues they may encounter.
* Integration of advanced technologies and equipment to support patients reaching their individual
  rehabilitation goals.
* We cater for all levels of amputation, utilising a broad range of techniques and technologies to
  help achieve client comfort and goals.
* Lower limb products including microprocessor knees and high energy storing feet.
* Upper limb prosthetics including myoelectric devices.
* Body-powered prosthetics and purely cosmetic prosthetics.
* After hours service, repairs and modifications.
* Design and manufacture of custom assistive technologies for adaptive athletes.

## Freedom Prosthetics is a registered…
* NDIS registered prosthetic service provider
* Queensland artificial limb service (QALS) prosthetic provider
* Medicare, Department of Veterans Affairs Provider
* Private insurance cover provider
* WorkCover prosthetic provider

## Benefits of investing in a prosthetic

There are many benefits to opting for a prosthetic, regardless of which body part you require a
replacement for. If you’re unconvinced about the monumental difference investing in a prosthetic can
make to your life, read on.

#### 1. Rehabilitation

If the loss of a limb or body part is still recent, investing in a prosthetic could really help with
the rehabilitation and recovery process. This is because it aids in a return to a new normality
thanks to some of the following benefits.

#### 2. Mobility

Depending on the body part you replace with a prosthetic, you could be greatly improving your
mobility. For example, leg or feet prosthetics allow you to move around more easily. All it takes is
the readjustment to how the prosthetic feels with the rest of your body; in no time at all, it’ll
feel completely natural!

#### 3. Independence

One of the largest frustrations for many amputees is adjusting to a lack of independence regarding
everyday tasks. This could be driving somewhere, picking things up, or just going about your
day-to-day activities unaided. While a prosthetic isn’t a full replacement for what used to be,
they’re the next closest thing you could have.

## FAQs

Below are a number of questions frequently asked by our prospective clients. If you have questions
yourself, have a look if they have been answered in our FAQ. For any other questions or requests,
feel free to get in touch with our team in Cairns or Townsville.

#### 1. When can I get a prosthesis?

How soon following an amputation or operation you can get a prosthesis depends on a few factors.
Namely, this includes post-surgical healing, existing medical conditions such as diabetes, and your
history of recovery time. We’ll go through this with you in more detail when you register your
interest in prosthetics.

#### 2. Will I be able to qualify for prosthetics?

More than likely, yes – the majority of amputees qualify for prosthetics. It ultimately comes down
to the placement and nature of where the prosthesis would be required. Some areas of the body can be
difficult to replace, and not all prosthetics provide a function. Your best bet is to speak with one
of our experts who can advise you on your individual situation.

#### 3. Are prosthetics easy to care for?

Yes! Most prosthetics are easy to clean; simply wipe clean and dry. Customer aftercare is a huge
part of the Freedom Prosthetics ethos, so we’ll run all of the prosthesis care advice through with
you following the casting and fitting stages.

## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

## About Kshemaa Prosthetics & Orthotics

[Three people with prosthetic legs standing confidently outdoors on a path in a park.]

#### WELCOME TO KSHEMAA

**KSHEMAA** was started in 2023, June. We provide the best and international Quality for the
Patients in Bangalore.



We have extensive experience at satisfying the needs of amputees, with access to a full specialist
multidisciplinary team who are all very experienced in amputee care. The team consists of a
Consultant in Prosthetists, Orthotist, dependent upon the requirements of the users.



**Our Mission:** To create awareness for our patients, becoming an integral part of the communities
we serve.



**Our Vision:** To provide quality and best service in Prosthetic, Orthotic, Wound care to each and
every patient in India at an affordable price with suitable prescription.



**Our values:** To inspire and to improve peoples' lives through competent and compassionate patient
care.

[A smiling woman with a prosthetic leg shows a hand gesture outdoors on a sunny path.]

#### WHY WE ?

The basis of a successful result is a comfortable socket. 



We have the skills and take the time to ensure comfort. Having determined that the socket is
comfortable we can concentrate on the functionality, for amputees that need prosthetic knees we are
experienced in all of the leading high functioning prosthetic knees. This includes the
Microprocessor Knee and Hands, like Rheo Knee and Sensor Knee as well as other knees from all of the
leading suppliers.



We use the full range of prosthetic feet including carbon fibre feet (blade runner type) shock
absorbing feet, energy storing feet, whichever is most suitable for your needs. 



Finally, if the appearance is of high importance, we are leading experts in high-definition silicone
prosthetics.

[Man with prosthetic leg doing a squat exercise outdoors.]

elsewhere.

## About Us

Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions aims to enhance the quality of life for all of our patients. We
fabricate prosthetic (artificial) limbs, braces, and a variety of orthotic devices for patients of
all ages in our state-of-the-art technical lab. Patient-centered care is a hallmark of our practice.

## Meet Our Team

At Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions, we believe that successful outcomes begin with
patient-practitioner relationships built on trust and honest communication. Great care goes into
matching patients with a practitioner who will be the right fit for them, whether they are here for
a short-term need or life-long condition. We are a team of problem solvers with exceptional skills
and experience in our respective areas of expertise.

[Learn More][40]

## Prosthetics

Our team appreciates the unique circumstances that bring each patient to us; experiences with
amputation are deeply personal and the path to recovery looks different for each person. Healing
from surgery, design and fit of a prosthetic device, and rehabilitation time vary by individual, but
each phase requires patience and persistence. We are here to listen, to problem solve, and to
celebrate the confidence you discover along the way – both with your device and within yourself.

[Learn More][41]

## Building a Community of Support

Hannah's Story

Our relationship with Hannah and her family began when she was just six months old. Now a vibrant,
tenacious preschooler, Hannah is achieving mobility goals and spreading joy wherever she goes. As is
true for many children, Hannah’s journey involves a team of people who are working together to
support her growth and development, and we are proud to be a part of her team. The comfort Hannah
and her family feel when they walk through our doors is our goal with every family we work with.

# Precision. Performance. Possibility.

Thank you for taking the time to learn about our unique approach to prosthetic patient care. Whether
you're a patient, caregiver, physician, therapist, case manager, or insurance representative, we
look forward to introducing you to a more holistic, individualized care experience.
 

At Prosthetic & Orthotic Associates, our team proudly serves patients across New York, Connecticut,
New Jersey, and Pennsylvania with a commitment to excellence in prosthetic and orthotic care.


Our patient-centered approach prioritizes each individual's needs, because there is no
one-size-fits-all solution. The POA Patient Care Process draws on our team's collective expertise to
deliver customized prosthetic solutions that support mobility, independence, and quality of life.
 

We work closely with every patient, tailoring prosthetics and rehabilitation plans to align with
their goals. We call them "Handspring Heroes" because we celebrate their resilience and
achievements.
 

At POA, we believe prosthetic care should consider the whole person, empowering you to live your
best life.

[Explore Our Care ][30]
[Screenshot 2025-04-28 125505.png]

## Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions Designed for You

At POA, we believe prosthetic and orthotic care should go beyond simply replacing lost function—it
should enhance your mobility, independence, and overall well-being. Our approach focuses on you as a
whole person, not just one aspect of your condition.


With expertise spanning a wide range of prosthetic and orthotic solutions, we tailor each device to
fit your unique goals, needs, and lifestyle. Whether you require a high-performance prosthesis for
an active lifestyle, a lightweight everyday solution, or specialized orthotic support, our team
works closely with you to ensure the best possible outcome.


By integrating cutting-edge technology, advanced materials, and personalized rehabilitation plans,
we help you move forward with confidence—because the right solution is the one designed just for
you.

## Welcome to PrimeCare Orthotics & Prosthetics

PrimeCare Orthotics & Prosthetics has been a leading provider of custom upper-limb and lower-limb
prosthetics in New Mexico since 2009. Our expert bilingual team offers compassionate care and
cutting-edge technology to enhance mobility and improve quality of life.

From custom prosthetic legs to hand prosthetics and orthotic devices, we tailor our services to meet
each client’s unique requirements. We strive to make each appointment a positive and memorable
experience, whether you are here for a single visit or require lifelong care.

Trust PrimeCare for expert craftsmanship, personalized attention, and comprehensive support on your
journey to greater independence and mobility.

## We Use Direct Socket System Technology

Discover the unparalleled benefits of our custom-made direct sockets at PrimeCare Orthotics &
Prosthetics.

Engineered for optimal structural integrity and energy transfer, our direct sockets revolutionize
your prosthetic experience. Experience a 30% increase in patient comfort with our innovative
solutions, crafted to fit your unique residual limb. Enjoy the convenience of same-day service
without compromising on quality. Our prosthetists in New Mexico carefully tailor each direct socket
to ensure the perfect balance of comfort and support, accelerating your rehabilitation journey and
enabling earlier gait training.

daily activities etc. On top of that, we will give you a physical evaluation to test general muscle
strength and flexibility.

2. Hand Casting

This is the first step in fitting and will involve an impression of the residual limb. The hand cast
will be made using a plaster to create a model to be modified to fit each specific patient.

3. Diagnostic Fittings

During the diagnostic fitting, it allows us to continue to adjust to any changes that might need to
be made throughout the alignment process as well as make it more comfortable overall.

In-House Fabrication simply makes it easier to make adjustments on site while you wait as well as
quick feedback.

### Engineering Prosthetic & Orthotic Solutions Since 1992

Proted’s vision is to produce the highest quality prosthetic and orthotic products in order to meet
the needs of disabled people and increase their general life quality.

Proted provides quality-certified services and has been awarded with a state grant for its advanced
technology infrastructure among leading manufacturing companies in Türkiye. Since becoming an
officially approved R&D Center by the Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology in 2017, Proted
has focused on high-technology research and development projects in the prosthetics and orthotics
sector.

Proted’s vision is to produce high-quality prosthetic and orthotic products that improve mobility,
independence, and overall quality of life for people with disabilities.

Operating from its integrated manufacturing facility in Ankara, Türkiye, Proted develops and
manufactures a wide range of prosthetic and orthotic technologies through its in-house engineering,
CNC machining, composite Carbon production, silicone processing, investment casting, and digital
manufacturing infrastructure.

Today, Proted exports and supplies its products to many countries across Europe, the Balkans, the
Baltic region, Africa, the Middle East, Canada, Turkic Republics, Asia, and the Far East, continuing
to expand its global presence with innovative and regionally manufactured high-technology solutions.

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

# Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics

Our sole focus is having positive patient outcomes! We provide advanced prosthetic & orthotic
solutions to improve your life!

[
Contact Summit O&PContact Summit O&P
][18]

## Improving Lives & Lifestyles!

Summit takes great pride in patient care. Here, you are not just another number! Oregon Based
Business: Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics is a locally-owned orthotic and prosthetic practice serving
Oregon since 1979. Our mission is to provide our community with the highest level of orthotic and
prosthetic care available using the latest technology and resources.

### Orthotics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides custom and off-the-shelf upper and lower extremity
orthotics.

[
Custom OrthoticsCustom Orthotics
][19]

### Prosthetics

Summit Orthotics & Prosthetics provides a variety of prosthetic services and care.

[
Prosthetics CareProsthetics Care
][20]

### Message from Todd

Having a family member as an amputee allows me to see the daily challenges of an amputee.

[
Message from ToddMessage from Todd
][21]

### Wounded Warriors

Summit O and P is a proud supporter and partner of the Wounded Warrior Project.

[
Wounded WarriorsWounded Warriors
][22]

## We Are Located in 9 Cities

# People of All Ages Welcome

We take time to listen to the needs of each of our patients, making sure we hear what is important.
We want to give you hope, that there is a better life ahead! We celebrate your successes and look to
build lasting relationships with our clients.

[
Discover a Place Near YouDiscover a Place Near You
][23]

##### Orthotics

Summit O&P works with your healthcare team for the best Orthotic solution.

Custom Orthotics

##### Prosthetics

Summit O&P prosthetics provide the best fit for a comfortable and mobile lifestyle.

Prosthetics Care

##### Resources

Life throws curveballs at us, and we hope to provide helpful information.

Mobility Resources

## Proudly serving our Veterans!

Many of our veterans have paid a tremendous price for their dedication, duty, and love of country.
We value each and every one of them and are more than grateful for their service. All of us at
Summit O and P are proud to be a part of their journey toward wellness and to assist them in
overcoming the challenges they face in gaining back their mobility. We will use the highest level of
orthotic and prosthetic care available with the latest technology and resources to help them advance
in their enjoyment and quality of life.

The Formula Fit is designed for active adolescents and small adults. It delivers flexible power, low
build height, and room to grow, bridging the gap between the Formula Ultra and the Pediatric
Formula, for reliable K3–K4 performance.

Наша миссия — помогать людям с ограниченными возможностями здоровья вести полноценную жизнь. Мы
находим и изучаем современные протезы, учитывая индивидуальные потребности человека.
[
Как выбрать протез руки
Пошаговая инструкция получения протеза руки по квоте: документы для ИПРА, сроки изготовления,
порядок обжалования отказа. Компенсация стоимости при самостоятельной покупке. Чем отличается
бионический протез от миоэлектрического? Сравнение технологий и функций
][86]
[
Протез ноги после ампутации
Узнайте всё о современных протезах ноги: какие бывают виды (бионические, механические, спортивные,
косметические), как проходит подбор и подгонка, что включает уход за культёй и протезом, как
справиться с фантомными болями и адаптироваться психологически.
][87]
[
Сколько стоит протез в 2025 году?
Узнайте, сколько стоит протез ноги, руки и бионический протез в 2025 году. Цены, сравнение моделей,
компенсация, квоты и налоговые льготы.
][88]
[
Ампутация конечностей: показания, техники операции, реабилитация и протезирование
Показания, уровни ампутации, дезартикуляция, ход операции. Индивидуальная программа реабилитации
(ИПР), бионические протезы, правовые аспекты в РФ. Для пациентов и специалистов.
][89]
[
Работа, принцип действия и современные технологии протезов, экзоскелетов
Как устроены современные бионические протезы рук и ног, чем отличаются экзоскелеты (активные и
пассивные), какие технологии управления используют, как происходит сенсорная обратная связь и
миоэлектрическое управление
][90]
[
Бионические протезы и импланты: полный анализ технологий
Полный гид по бионическим протезам, нейроимплантам и кибернетическим технологиям. Обзор моделей
(i-Limb, LUKE Arm), принципов работы, стоимости и реабилитации. Как выбрать современный протез?
][91]
[
Инвалидность при ампутации ноги: группа, оформление, вопросы
Подробно о порядке оформления инвалидности после ампутации ноги: критерии присвоения группы (1, 2,
3), документы для МСЭ, особенности переосвидетельствования, льготы и выплаты, юридические основания,
трудоспособность, частые проблемы и альтернативы поддержки для пациентов в России.
][92]
[
Остеоинтеграция протеза ноги: этапы, риски и результаты
Остеоинтеграция протеза ноги — это прямое соединение имплантата с костью для естественной ходьбы без
гильзы. В статье — технологии, этапы, риски, клинические результаты и сравнение с альтернативными
методами протезирования.
][93]
[
Аномалии развития конечностей (аплазия и др.), причины
В статье рассматриваются причины возникновения аномалий конечностей — от генетических до внешних
факторов, обсуждаются методы диагностики, различия между видами дефектов, клинические особенности,
способы лечения и роль междисциплинарной команды в ведении пациентов.
][94]
[
Экзоскелет — что это такое, каким бывает и как работает
Экзоскелет — это устройство, усиливающее движение человека или животного благодаря внешнему каркасу.
В статье простыми словами объясним, что такое экзоскелеты, их виды, принципы работы, назначение и

# Home

Global Disability Innovation Hub accelerates ideas into impact for a more just world - for disabled
people, and all people.

We work in 40+ countries and have reached 64 million people since 2016. A world-leading Academic
Research and Practice Centre based at UCL, we are the first WHO Global Collaborating Centre on
Assistive Technology.

## AT2030 programme: Testing ‘what works’ to improve access to life-changing AT for all

We bring effective solutions to market by testing new mechanisms and ambitious scaling pathways for
growth-ready accessible and assistive technology ventures. From incubating future tech inspired
solutions to delivering ecosystem interventions - we strengthen systems to make inclusion a reality
and embed disability innovation into national policy landscapes. Generating new evidence and
insights, we stimulate demand, deliver country pilots and create enabling markets environment for
AT in Low-and Middle- Income Countries. 

[at2030.org][33]
[A black woman holds an ipad for a black man, who looks at it intently]

## Centre for Digital Language Inclusion: Using AI to bridge the barrier between impaired speech and
## Automatic Speech Recognition

Harnessing the power of AI the centre develops inclusive solutions for people with communication
difficulties. With support from Google.org, we are collecting impaired and non-standard speech for
languages across Africa, South America and Europe for the first time. Currently Automatic Speech
Recognition (ASR) technology is not available to those who would most benefit: non-English-speaking
populations in low- middle- income countries, who often have the least access to AT and speech and
language therapy. Our open source data sets will change this.
 

[cdl-inclusion.com][34]
[UCL graduating image, with 30 students celebrating, throwing hats into the air]

## Disability, Design & Innovation MSc: our UCL based MSc to tackle global challenges from a new
## perspective.

Design engineering meet global policy and the societal context of disability, this multidisciplinary
programme takes theory into practice, equipping emerging pioneers to tackle the complex problems
faced by people with a range of disabilities. Designed for those passionate about creating
accessible and assistive technologies and inclusive designs, this programme equips students with the
skills to make a significant impact in disability innovation.

[More about our Masters Degree][35]

## Inclusive Cities, Global Action Report

Highlight

This report equips cities with practical but evidence-based actions to accelerate accessibility and
inclusion in their physical infrastructure, buildings, services and operation. Cities worldwide are
experiencing continued growth and increasing resource challenges. With resource constraints and
increasing global challenges (rising inequality, climate changes, pandemics), it is critical that
accessibility and inclusive design are seamlessly integrated into the planning and design of cities,
to create liveable and enjoyable cities and ensure persons with disabilities are not left behind. 

[Global Action Report][36] [Person in wheelchair approaching place of worship in India]

## The first World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre for Research on Assistive
## Technology

Highlight

Our UCL based Collaborating Centre supports WHO’s efforts to widen global access to Assistive
Technology around humanitarian response, driving advances in digital technology and artificial
intelligence, and working to develop and implement a One-Stop-Shop Model of Assistive Product
service provision. The centre pioneers key research and innovation on Assistive Technologies
worldwide.

[WHO Collaborating Centre][37] [A Kenyan women holding a mobile phone while smiling at the camera]

# Home

Global Disability Innovation Hub accelerates ideas into impact for a more just world - for disabled
people, and all people.

We work in 40+ countries and have reached 64 million people since 2016. A world-leading Academic
Research and Practice Centre based at UCL, we are the first WHO Global Collaborating Centre on
Assistive Technology.

## AT2030 programme: Testing ‘what works’ to improve access to life-changing AT for all

We bring effective solutions to market by testing new mechanisms and ambitious scaling pathways for
growth-ready accessible and assistive technology ventures. From incubating future tech inspired
solutions to delivering ecosystem interventions - we strengthen systems to make inclusion a reality
and embed disability innovation into national policy landscapes. Generating new evidence and
insights, we stimulate demand, deliver country pilots and create enabling markets environment for
AT in Low-and Middle- Income Countries. 

[at2030.org][33]
[A black woman holds an ipad for a black man, who looks at it intently]

## Centre for Digital Language Inclusion: Using AI to bridge the barrier between impaired speech and
## Automatic Speech Recognition

Harnessing the power of AI the centre develops inclusive solutions for people with communication
difficulties. With support from Google.org, we are collecting impaired and non-standard speech for
languages across Africa, South America and Europe for the first time. Currently Automatic Speech
Recognition (ASR) technology is not available to those who would most benefit: non-English-speaking
populations in low- middle- income countries, who often have the least access to AT and speech and
language therapy. Our open source data sets will change this.
 

[cdl-inclusion.com][34]
[UCL graduating image, with 30 students celebrating, throwing hats into the air]

## Disability, Design & Innovation MSc: our UCL based MSc to tackle global challenges from a new
## perspective.

Design engineering meet global policy and the societal context of disability, this multidisciplinary
programme takes theory into practice, equipping emerging pioneers to tackle the complex problems
faced by people with a range of disabilities. Designed for those passionate about creating
accessible and assistive technologies and inclusive designs, this programme equips students with the
skills to make a significant impact in disability innovation.

[More about our Masters Degree][35]

## Inclusive Cities, Global Action Report

Highlight

This report equips cities with practical but evidence-based actions to accelerate accessibility and
inclusion in their physical infrastructure, buildings, services and operation. Cities worldwide are
experiencing continued growth and increasing resource challenges. With resource constraints and
increasing global challenges (rising inequality, climate changes, pandemics), it is critical that
accessibility and inclusive design are seamlessly integrated into the planning and design of cities,
to create liveable and enjoyable cities and ensure persons with disabilities are not left behind. 

[Global Action Report][36] [Person in wheelchair approaching place of worship in India]

## The first World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre for Research on Assistive
## Technology

Highlight

Our UCL based Collaborating Centre supports WHO’s efforts to widen global access to Assistive
Technology around humanitarian response, driving advances in digital technology and artificial
intelligence, and working to develop and implement a One-Stop-Shop Model of Assistive Product
service provision. The centre pioneers key research and innovation on Assistive Technologies
worldwide.

[WHO Collaborating Centre][37] [A Kenyan women holding a mobile phone while smiling at the camera]

## Disability Innovation Strategy

Highlight

Our vision is for disability inclusion and social justice. We work towards a world without barriers
to participation, where everyone has the opportunity to live a joyful life. Find out more about our
5 year strategy, and how we accelerate new solutions through innovative partnerships and
multi-disciplinary thinking. Bridging world leading academic research and practice we to power new
knowledge and ideas.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

# Welcome to Findlay American Prosthetics & Orthotics Centre

A Passion For Putting Patients First With Prosthetics & Orthotics.
**Your Future, Your Mobility, Our Expertise**
Dedicated to Excellence, Rooted in Compassion: Where Your Well-being Takes Centre Stage with Our
Prosthetic and Orthotic Care. Your Journey to Comfort, Mobility, and Confidence Begins Here.
[Make An Appointment][16]

## Prosthetic Fitting in Findlay, Ohio

Welcome to Findlay Prosthetic & Orthotic Centre, the leading provider of prosthetic and orthotic
services in Findlay, Ohio. Our mission is to offer perfect prosthetic fitting and comprehensive
orthotic solutions tailored to your unique needs. Our experienced team uses advanced technology to
ensure optimal mobility and comfort.

## About Us

Mr. Jeremy Berman L.P.O. was born & raised in rural Hancock County. As a youth Mr. Berman
participated in school athletics & scouting. As a culmination in scouting he achieved the Eagle
Scout Award. Mr. Berman graduated from Riverdale H.S. & was named Senior Student of the Year for
Hardin County Schools. Mr. Berman enlisted in the Ohio Army National Guard for an eight year
enlistment & during his service was deployed following the 9/11 attack. Mr. Berman graduated from
Bowling Green State University in Bowling Green, Ohio with an undergraduate degree in Human Movement
Science - Kinesiology with a minor in Sociology. Mr. Berman graduated from Northwestern Medical
School in Chicago, Illinois with a graduate degree in Orthotics and Prosthetics. Following two years
of residency Mr. Berman became a board certified/licensed practitioner in Prosthetics & Orthotics.
Over two decades Mr. Berman has been the managing partner of Findlay American Prosthetic - Orthotic
Centre in Findlay, Ohio. Mr. Berman is married with one child.
Mr. Berman is a proud second generation practitioner and facility owner. He began working with his
father Mr. Ken Berman L.P.O when he was 13 years old in the family business.
Mr. Kenneth Berman L.P.O. started the business in 1975. Mr. Berman also received his education from
Northwestern Medical school in Chicago, was an Eagle Scout, and an Air Force veteran. Mr. Berman was
active in the state of Ohio with establishing licensure for the profession and was one of the first
to become licensed. Mr. Berman found the profession extremely rewarding and has helped thousands of
amputees regain mobility. Mr. Berman is currently retired and happily living in Florida with his
wife.
[Gate Room - Findlay]

## Our Services

Our commitment is to provide personalized prosthetic & orthotic solutions that not only restore
function but also inspire confidence. Whether you're embarking on a new chapter after amputation or
seeking an upgrade for your current prosthetic or orthotic device, our team of experts is dedicated
to crafting solutions that align with your unique needs and aspirations.

## [Our Products][13]

Prosthetics can be a big part of your life and your identity. So, it’s only right you choose a
specialist to deliver the most comfortable, supportive and reliable prosthetics for your needs.
Freedom Prosthetics is a provider and fabricator of prosthetic limbs and care with clinic in Cairns.

## Products and Services:
* The latest technology in prosthetic carving with 3D scanning not previously available in Far North
  Queensland.
* Consulting physiotherapist and occupational therapist.
* Manufacture of all our custom devices on-site in Cairns with quick turn-around.
* Full range of prefabricated and customised orthotics systems available.
* Amputee support for any issues they may encounter.
* Integration of advanced technologies and equipment to support patients reaching their individual
  rehabilitation goals.
* We cater for all levels of amputation, utilising a broad range of techniques and technologies to
  help achieve client comfort and goals.
* Lower limb products including microprocessor knees and high energy storing feet.
* Upper limb prosthetics including myoelectric devices.
* Body-powered prosthetics and purely cosmetic prosthetics.
* After hours service, repairs and modifications.
* Design and manufacture of custom assistive technologies for adaptive athletes.

## Freedom Prosthetics is a registered…
* NDIS registered prosthetic service provider
* Queensland artificial limb service (QALS) prosthetic provider
* Medicare, Department of Veterans Affairs Provider
* Private insurance cover provider
* WorkCover prosthetic provider

## Benefits of investing in a prosthetic

There are many benefits to opting for a prosthetic, regardless of which body part you require a
replacement for. If you’re unconvinced about the monumental difference investing in a prosthetic can
make to your life, read on.

#### 1. Rehabilitation

If the loss of a limb or body part is still recent, investing in a prosthetic could really help with
the rehabilitation and recovery process. This is because it aids in a return to a new normality
thanks to some of the following benefits.

#### 2. Mobility

Depending on the body part you replace with a prosthetic, you could be greatly improving your
mobility. For example, leg or feet prosthetics allow you to move around more easily. All it takes is
the readjustment to how the prosthetic feels with the rest of your body; in no time at all, it’ll
feel completely natural!

#### 3. Independence

One of the largest frustrations for many amputees is adjusting to a lack of independence regarding
everyday tasks. This could be driving somewhere, picking things up, or just going about your
day-to-day activities unaided. While a prosthetic isn’t a full replacement for what used to be,
they’re the next closest thing you could have.

## FAQs

Below are a number of questions frequently asked by our prospective clients. If you have questions
yourself, have a look if they have been answered in our FAQ. For any other questions or requests,
feel free to get in touch with our team in Cairns or Townsville.

#### 1. When can I get a prosthesis?

How soon following an amputation or operation you can get a prosthesis depends on a few factors.
Namely, this includes post-surgical healing, existing medical conditions such as diabetes, and your
history of recovery time. We’ll go through this with you in more detail when you register your
interest in prosthetics.

#### 2. Will I be able to qualify for prosthetics?

More than likely, yes – the majority of amputees qualify for prosthetics. It ultimately comes down
to the placement and nature of where the prosthesis would be required. Some areas of the body can be
difficult to replace, and not all prosthetics provide a function. Your best bet is to speak with one
of our experts who can advise you on your individual situation.

#### 3. Are prosthetics easy to care for?

Yes! Most prosthetics are easy to clean; simply wipe clean and dry. Customer aftercare is a huge
part of the Freedom Prosthetics ethos, so we’ll run all of the prosthesis care advice through with
you following the casting and fitting stages.

# Prosthetics Cairns

## [Our Services][11]

## [Our Facility][12]

## [Our Products][13]

Prosthetics can be a big part of your life and your identity. So, it’s only right you choose a
specialist to deliver the most comfortable, supportive and reliable prosthetics for your needs.
Freedom Prosthetics is a provider and fabricator of prosthetic limbs and care with clinic in Cairns.

## Products and Services:
* The latest technology in prosthetic carving with 3D scanning not previously available in Far North
  Queensland.
* Consulting physiotherapist and occupational therapist.
* Manufacture of all our custom devices on-site in Cairns with quick turn-around.
* Full range of prefabricated and customised orthotics systems available.
* Amputee support for any issues they may encounter.
* Integration of advanced technologies and equipment to support patients reaching their individual
  rehabilitation goals.
* We cater for all levels of amputation, utilising a broad range of techniques and technologies to
  help achieve client comfort and goals.
* Lower limb products including microprocessor knees and high energy storing feet.
* Upper limb prosthetics including myoelectric devices.
* Body-powered prosthetics and purely cosmetic prosthetics.
* After hours service, repairs and modifications.
* Design and manufacture of custom assistive technologies for adaptive athletes.

## Freedom Prosthetics is a registered…
* NDIS registered prosthetic service provider
* Queensland artificial limb service (QALS) prosthetic provider
* Medicare, Department of Veterans Affairs Provider
* Private insurance cover provider
* WorkCover prosthetic provider

## Benefits of investing in a prosthetic

There are many benefits to opting for a prosthetic, regardless of which body part you require a
replacement for. If you’re unconvinced about the monumental difference investing in a prosthetic can
make to your life, read on.

#### 1. Rehabilitation

If the loss of a limb or body part is still recent, investing in a prosthetic could really help with
the rehabilitation and recovery process. This is because it aids in a return to a new normality
thanks to some of the following benefits.

#### 2. Mobility

Depending on the body part you replace with a prosthetic, you could be greatly improving your
mobility. For example, leg or feet prosthetics allow you to move around more easily. All it takes is
the readjustment to how the prosthetic feels with the rest of your body; in no time at all, it’ll
feel completely natural!

#### 3. Independence

One of the largest frustrations for many amputees is adjusting to a lack of independence regarding
everyday tasks. This could be driving somewhere, picking things up, or just going about your
day-to-day activities unaided. While a prosthetic isn’t a full replacement for what used to be,
they’re the next closest thing you could have.

## FAQs

Below are a number of questions frequently asked by our prospective clients. If you have questions
yourself, have a look if they have been answered in our FAQ. For any other questions or requests,
feel free to get in touch with our team in Cairns or Townsville.

#### 1. When can I get a prosthesis?

How soon following an amputation or operation you can get a prosthesis depends on a few factors.
Namely, this includes post-surgical healing, existing medical conditions such as diabetes, and your
history of recovery time. We’ll go through this with you in more detail when you register your
interest in prosthetics.

#### 2. Will I be able to qualify for prosthetics?

More than likely, yes – the majority of amputees qualify for prosthetics. It ultimately comes down
to the placement and nature of where the prosthesis would be required. Some areas of the body can be
difficult to replace, and not all prosthetics provide a function. Your best bet is to speak with one
of our experts who can advise you on your individual situation.

#### 3. Are prosthetics easy to care for?

Yes! Most prosthetics are easy to clean; simply wipe clean and dry. Customer aftercare is a huge
part of the Freedom Prosthetics ethos, so we’ll run all of the prosthesis care advice through with
you following the casting and fitting stages.
